scripts.build: node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build && node -e "require('esbuild').buildSync({ entryPoints: ['server.ts'], bundle: true, platform: 'node', format: 'cjs', packages: 'external', sourcemap: true, outfile: 'dist/server.cjs' });"
scripts.build:desktop: node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build && node node_modules/esbuild/bin/esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --outfile=dist/server.cjs && node node_modules/electron/cli.js .
scripts.dist: node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build && node node_modules/esbuild/bin/esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --outfile=dist/server.cjs && node node_modules/electron-builder/out/cli/cli.js --win
scripts.build:exe: node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build && node node_modules/esbuild/bin/esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --outfile=dist/server.cjs && node node_modules/electron-builder/out/cli/cli.js --win
scripts.dist:all: npm run dist && npm run build:apk
scripts.test:all: node node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs tests/run-all.ts && node node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs tests/ai-qa-tester.ts
